name: JSON to XML
summary: Convert JSON to XML with attributes via @keys — locally in your browser.
description: Paste JSON and get XML. Single-key objects become the root element; otherwise a configurable root wraps the payload. Use @attr for attributes and #text for text nodes. Runs entirely locally.

faqs.question: How do I set XML attributes?
faqs.answer: Use keys that start with @, for example "@id": "1" becomes id="1" on the element.

faqs.question: What about arrays?
faqs.answer: Array items become repeated elements with the same tag name.

faqs.question: Is my data uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser.
